notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[p]Howdy Folks![/p][p] [/p][p]First and foremost I want to thank everyone for the support and wishlists. It’s great to see the interest in my game quickly growing. I wanted to update you all on what I've been working on as well as what you can expect next.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Recycler Machine[/h3][p]The recycler in the available demo has been completely reworked and now included new animations and audio effects.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8BBqg4THT4Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]
[/p][h3]Echo Spheres[/h3][p]In each of the current levels there are small data sticks that can be read that provide some story/lore. These are quite small and easy to miss. They also don’t make sense to be left behind just to be read.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480240/3605e19eb31d33ea151998ffcd43266add27a128.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]To fix both problems they’ve been replaced by echo spheres. These are easier to spot glowing spheres that can be read by the robot. They are echoes of the past that have been imprinted at those locations.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Demo[/h3][p]I’m currently working to finalize an updated demo that will include the above content as well as multiplayer support. The new demo will be a great way to check out PACK with your friends. The new demo is expected to be available next month so keep an eye out.[/p][p][/p][h3]Release Date[/h3][p]The release date into early access is still to be determined, but I lot of progress has been made on additional levels for the final release. Stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks again for all the support and feedback and be sure to wishlist PACK if you haven’t already. Join the discord and let give me your feedback, suggestions or just say howdy.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Follow & Support[/u][/p][p] [url="bit.ly/packgamesim"]Wishlist[/url] | [url="https://discord.gg/ZAT4v8wJSb"]Discord[/url] | [url="patreon.com/nitrousbutterfly"]Patreon[/url][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Developer Log #1
notes.content:
Howdy Folks!

A huge thank you if you checked out the demo on Itch.IO and for the great feedback. Since the release of the demo, I’ve been hard at work implementing new features, fixing up issues and working on new content. The current goal is to release a brand new demo on Steam, but I wanted to go over what it is that I’ve been working on.

[h2]Throwable Objects[/h2]
Objects that can be picked up have already had the ability to be tossed a bit by swinging the camera view, but now they can be thrown with a separate button press. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480240/b75dccd307f986ac47f630bf58e76b6e6ec6bc5f.gif[/img]

[h2]Creating Trash Cubes[/h2]
Originally players would automatically generate a trash cube when the vacuum tool is full. This will no longer be the case in future versions and the player will be required to press a button to stamp out a trash cube when the vacuum tool is full. 

This also means some tweaks to the existing UI to better show the player when the vacuum is full as well as some visual and audio additions to make it more clear why you’ve suddenly stopped vacuuming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480240/490b6cb835cc71b03fa7bb0ec092e74b359e2461.png[/img]

You’ll be able to empty the vacuum any time it has anything in it, not only when it’s full. The created trash cubes are scaled relative to how full the vacuum was at the time it was created.

[h2]Repairable Objects [/h2]
My original vision of PACK included the ability to repair or restore objects in the environment. The alpha demo did not include this feature, but I’ve been working hard on a new system that will allow the player to acquire resources while cleaning that can be used to repair broken objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480240/14db3ca6529038a10e3830b369e563a93a4c1bf9.png[/img]

Vacuumable objects in the environment will now contain resources. When these resources are packaged into a trash cube and deposited into the recycler the resources can then be used to repair objects.

Repairable objects have a repair cost and if you have enough available resources you’ll be able to repair the object by interacting with it.


[h2]Steam Demo[/h2]
Keep an eye out for a demo here on Steam that will include additional content and showcase the new features covered above. 

Be sure to Wishlist PACK today!

notes.title: P.A.C.K. :: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit is now available to wishlist on Steam!
notes.content:
I'm super excited to announce that my game P.A.C.K. :: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit is now available on Steam to wishlist!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x3cFpJLWC1I

[h2]About P.A.C.K. :: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit[/h2]
P.A.C.K. is a first-person cleaning simulation game where users play as a robot designed to clean up after natural disasters. The only problem is that it’s the end of the world …but that’s never stopped a robot from carrying out its objectives. Wash, vacuum and clear debris from abandoned structures while learning about the ultimate fate of mankind, alone or with up to 3 friends.

The game is expected to release into early access on Steam later this year. To learn more and keep up to date with the latest news about P.A.C.K., wishlist it on Steam, visit the [url=https://www.packgamesim.com]game’s website[/url], join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/ZAT4v8wJSb]Discord[/url], or help support development by [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/nitrousbutterfly]becoming a Patron[/url].

[h2]About Me (The Developer)[/h2]
My name is Tim Pelham and I'm a solo video game developer. I'm the creator and solo developer of Mercury Fallen. P.A.C.K. :: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit is my next adventure and I hope you'll join me as I endeavor to create an enjoyable casual cleaning experience.

As a solo developer it greatly helps to get feedback and especially funding to help support development and keep a roof over my head while I squirrel away the hours behind my desk. If you want to help support development you can [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/nitrousbutterfly]become a patron[/url] for as little as $1. This will help keep development going as well as give access to early alpha builds of the game.
